notes.title: Gameplay trailer release
notes.notes:
[h1]🎬 Official Trailer – Enter the Labyrinth[/h1]

[quote]The official trailer for [i]Labyrinth: Dracula’s Lair[/i] is now live on Steam.  
This is your first glimpse into the dark and twisted journey that awaits you…[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597020/aa6e68e73a779d484a164ec9c5676b988dc26089.png[/img]

[h2]🦇 What Awaits You[/h2]

[quote]A first-person horror exploration game set in a decaying underground world —  
Where stealth, fear, and limited resources are your only tools for survival.  
The fog hides monsters.  
The monsters hunt.  
And only through cursed relics can you see what stalks you.[/quote]

[h2]❤️ Add the game to Your Wishlist[/h2]

[quote]If this world speaks to you, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689090/]add it to your wishlist[/url] to be notified at launch.  

[b]It’s a small click that helps me tremendously as a solo developer.[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689090/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597020/e01ecedbdd298dd460622e972c362c1ad1cc63be.png[/img][/url][/quote]

[h2]💬 I’d love to receive your Feedback[/h2]

[quote]Let me know what you think of the trailer!  

What intrigued you? What left you uneasy? What do you want to see more of?

Thanks for being here.  
This trailer is just the beginning.  [/quote]

[i]The Labyrinth is calling…[/i]
